# Overview

This page embeds the Quarto reveal.js deck built from the doctorants
deconvolution seminar (sources under `slides/` in the repository).
Pattern inspired by
[GTBioSS_slides.qmd](https://github.com/bastienchassagnol/COPASI_Team216_Lo2016/blob/master/vignettes/GTBioSS_slides.qmd)
and the
[quarto-webr slide-embed example](https://quarto-webr.thecoatlessprofessor.com/examples/book/slide-embed.html#presentation).

[Open the deck full screen](https://bastienchassagnol.github.io/DeCovarT/slides/index.html).

```{=html}
<iframe
  class="slides"
  src="https://bastienchassagnol.github.io/DeCovarT/slides/index.html"
  title="DeCovarT doctorants deconvolution slides"
  width="100%"
  height="600"
  style="border: 1px solid #ccc;"
  allowfullscreen
></iframe>
```

```{=html}
<style>
iframe.slides {
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  min-height: 480px;
}
</style>
```
